0022600141.text: The Spurs (2-2) are at the Utah Jazz (1-3) for their fifth game of the season, with San Antonio sitting 7th in the West, two games back in the Southwest, and riding a two-game winning streak. Utah is 13th in the West and has lost its last two games. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 126-109 win in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026, and no games between the teams have been played yet this season.
